6. AIMCAM  PROGRAMMING  
ISO programming language (G and M codes) is used for easy programming in the creation of mac ro 
programs. Thanks to the ISO programming language, it is very easy to write all kinds of machine 
opera tions, as well as the management of all machine functions can be easily provided. When the 
measurement values required by the macro -operation  are entered by the operator, the machine 
automatically creates the program in the background and can perform the  selected macro operation 
on the profile.  
While programming the required macro, it is possible to change the speed, cutting speed, tool 
number, profile reference point in the same way.  
In addition, the program can be run quickly by entering the profile hei ght and width measurement 
from the screen, without the need to get a tool zero each time according to the profile.

maintenance purposes.  
 
 
8. PROFIL E CLAMPING SYSTEM  
Profile clamping system is composed of 4-8 clamps. The clamps work as 2 and 4  by different hand 
buttons. The purpose of operating the clamps  separately is to enable simultaneous machininh  of two 
separate profiles in the machining bed of t he machine.  
  By means of CAMPROX  software , the c lamps are repositioned automatically by machine depending on 
the processes performed on workpiece.
